item.title: The Moment Doesn’t Take Charli XCX Seriously & Neither Should We
item.description: Mild spoilers ahead. Charli XCX hates being famous. She’s also terrified of becoming irrelevant. She loves pop music but couldn’t care less about being a pop star. item.title: I Went to Portland & Found a Beautiful Latine Community in These Shops
item.description: While Oregon became a state in 1859, Latines have been part of the region for more than 150 years. Arriving mostly from Mexico within decades of statehood and, in some cases, before it, they often came as laborers, working railroads, agriculture, mining, and ranching.
